name: What causes black spots on my ceiling?

mainEntity.name: What causes black spots on my ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Black spots on a ceiling are commonly caused by mold or mildew growth, which thrives in damp, humid environments. This can result from leaks in the roof or pipes, condensation buildup due to poor ventilation, or water damage from a previous incident. Identifying the source of moisture is crucial for effective removal and prevention. Without addressing the underlying water issue, black spots are likely to reappear, potentially leading to more extensive damage and health concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Black spots on ceilings are usually caused by mold or mildew from moisture, such as leaks or condensation. Identifying and fixing the water source is essential.
